text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option a 16.0 to 16.8 s. Medium creek view. Background trees and the left ledge shift left while the white car stays near center, giving an impression of the car moving right relative to the bank. The car rides lower: by 16.8 s water reaches just under the windows, roof pod still visible. Dark marks inside windows are not readable as occupant or empty. No sideways lift is distinct.
